d:
"Getting digested by your favourite vtuber must be heaven for their fans... Too bad she won't remember you the moment you disappear into her tits."

A remake of one of my more recent animations, I'm not sure why I wanted to do this one in Koikatsu, but I really wanted to. This time, I decided to switch up from my usual static camera/changing body style, since I realized that works much better in 2D than 3D. The disposal was a bit of a challenge, but I think it came out much better than I was expecting.
